Network Graph

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/network-graphs.Rmd
network-graphs.Rmd

Read Graph File

We are using the well-known social network of Zachary's karate club, which ships with igraph as a named graph (make_graph("Zachary")). A GML format file can also be collected from here.

library(plotly.core)
library(igraph)

G <- make_graph("Zachary")
V(G)$label <- paste("Member", seq_len(vcount(G)))
L <- layout_in_circle(G)

Create Vertices and Edges 

vs <- V(G)
es <- as.data.frame(as_edgelist(G))

Nv <- length(vs)
Ne <- length(es[1]$V1)

Create Nodes 

library(plotly.core)

Xn <- L[, 1]
Yn <- L[, 2]

network <- go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = Xn,
    y = Yn,
    mode = "markers",
    text = vs$label,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  )

Creates Edges 

network <- network |>
  # igraph also has an add_shape()
  plotly.core::add_shape(
    type = "line",
    line = go_shape_line(color = "#030303", width = 0.3),
    x0 = Xn[es$V1],
    y0 = Yn[es$V1],
    x1 = Xn[es$V2],
    y1 = Yn[es$V2]
  )

Create Network 

network |>
  update_layout(
    title = "Karate Network",
    xaxis = go_xaxis(
      title = "",
      showgrid = FALSE,
      showticklabels = FALSE,
      zeroline = FALSE
    ),
    yaxis = go_yaxis(
      title = "",
      showgrid = FALSE,
      showticklabels = FALSE,
      zeroline = FALSE
    )
  )

Reference

See go_scatter() and go_shape() for more information and chart attribute options!
